last_debrief: STORY SO FAR: Wed 08-26, day 15 in country. THE EAR PAID AND THE MOUTH FOLLOWED INSIDE ONE SESSION. Opened on the owed auto-turn trailer as lore, not drill: thirumbu = turn AND return, which is why thirumba = again; and ponga is precisely WHY the driver never turns — you told him to carry on. Junction drill rendered 15:41 and pushed to the lock screen. EAR FIRST, AND IT WAS THE RIGHT CALL. Gave him 'neram aachu, kadai moodiduchu' cold — he decoded the whole shape off two words he had never been given, and named -uchu as 'past'. Sharpened it to the IT-tail: nobody closed the shop, it closed; the world did it, stop hunting for the doer. Lore that stuck: moodu = cover, and the moodi is the LID on her vessel. Then a two-auntie eavesdrop. He got line one half right and read 'avanga' as WE — placed it for him on yesterday's naanga/naama ladder, which is exactly why that tangent was worth telling. Line two he missed whole: heard 'kadaisila' and went shopping, via kadai. THAT IS A REAL EAR TRAP AND WORTH REUSING — kadai-la (at the shop) vs kadaisi-la (at the end), one syllable apart, opposite ends of the sentence. summa solraanga given live for the first time; told him the table files every announced plan under summa until it happens. THREE FIRES, ONE AUTO-RIDE SCENE. (1) The turn: 'medhuva ponga, valadhu pakkam thirumbunga'. The turn word is HINTED not cold and I told him so — I had written it in the trailer twenty minutes earlier. But 'medhuva ponga' is genuinely his: he pulled medhuva out of the chunk 'konjam medhuva sollunga' and bolted it to ponga. PARTS ASSEMBLED — the exact opposite of chunk-not-machine, and I named it to him as such. (2) appadi illa FIRED COLD AND UNAIDED — three sessions owed, and this time I never once wrote it in the session. Driver asked 'neenga tourist-aa?' and he led with the denial then the tail: 'appadi illa, mappilai irukken'. Head-then-tail, the 08-25 seat framing holding a day later. The word is his now. (3) 'Beach-ku ponom, romba nallaa irundhuchu' — ponom HELD cold one day after landing; -ku correct and unprompted, which closes ku-vs-la with no correction from me; and irundhuchu came out of his mouth ten minutes after he DECODED that same tail. Ear to mouth inside one session is the fastest conversion I have seen from him. NEW SLIP, ONE INSTANCE, NOT COMMISSIONED: copula-for-identity. 'mappilai irukken' — irukken is WHERE and HOW you are, never WHO you are; an identity sentence in Tamil has no verb at all. English made him reach for the 'am'. Watch it; do not dose it yet. THE BIG ONE — I HAVE BEEN DESIGNING MISSIONS WRONG, NOT TRIGGERS. romba alaichal died unfired: 'I didn't find an opening.' That is the FOURTH mission to die at the trigger, and I had already unwelded this exact one on 08-25 and re-blamed the trigger. Stop. Look at what fired today: the driver's near-miss, the driver's question, maami's question, the aunties talking across him — EVERY SINGLE ONE WAS AN ANSWER. He is strong in the RESPONSE slot and dying in the INITIATION slot, and every mission I have ever assigned has been self-initiated speech into a room that was not asking, which is the hardest speech act in the language. RETIRED romba alaichal from the board — kept the word. New mission is an ANSWER with a guaranteed daily slot: she asks 'innikki enna panninga?' every night, and he answers with the sentence he built himself today. ASKED HIM ONE DIAGNOSTIC AND THE ANSWER IS PENDING: was nobody around, or did it feel wrong to announce his own weariness in someone else's house? Those need opposite fixes and I would rather ask than guess a fifth time. COMMISSIONED: sinna-for-konjam (2x over 15d, never once dosed) — soak lane, konjam permuted across his own table items, sinna parked where it belongs. STILL OPEN: english-word-order is 3x over 23d and STILL never commissioned, but the 08-19 carve BROKE under him — the three instances are not one crime — so it needs a true carve before it can carry a dose; do not build one on the broken rule. chunk-not-machine did not fire today. pirandha naal vazhthukkal: in curriculum, no deadline, her real day in her real room. TOMORROW OFFERED: Ear Day, two voices at speed / low-power twin is the junction track with no talking.
